description.value: Savary Island Pie Company is a bakery on Marine Drive in North Vancouver, a popular cycling corridor on the North Shore. Named after Savary Island off the Sunshine Coast, it offers indoor seating in a no-smoking environment. It sits along a well-travelled route for cyclists connecting the waterfront to the broader North Shore trail network.
